title: Describing a substance: singular adjective
focus: When describing a substance after on (“is”), use a singular partitive adjective: Kahvi on kuumaa. — The coffee is hot.

exercises.prompt: Complete “The coffee is hot.” Kahvi on ____.
exercises.explanation: When describing a substance as an uncounted substance in this pattern, use a singular partitive adjective after on or ei ole. Keep kuuma and add -a: kuuma + a = kuumaa.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Describing a substance: singular adjective: form or use confused

optionFeedback.kuumaa: When describing a substance as an uncounted substance in this pattern, use a singular partitive adjective after on or ei ole. Keep kuuma and add -a: kuuma + a = kuumaa.
optionFeedback.kuuma: kuuma is not the required partitive form for this meaning. When describing a substance as an uncounted substance in this pattern, use a singular partitive adjective after on or ei ole.
optionFeedback.kuumia: kuumia does not express the requested case and number here. Keep kuuma and add -a: kuuma + a = kuumaa.
